entities.label: Place
entities.summary: Cougar Helicopters Flight 91 was a scheduled flight of a Cougar Sikorsky S-92A, which ditched on 12 March 2009 en route to the SeaRose FPSO in the White Rose oil field and Hibernia Platform in the Hibernia oilfield off the coast of Newfoundland 55 kilometres (34 mi) east-southeast of St. John's, Newfoundland. Of the 18 aboard, only one survived.
